champion: Long time ago, for Edo land, one young wrestler wey dem dey call Joromi come popular well well because of im strength.
champion-2: When he enter village square, everybody wan watch am.
skill: Im legs sharp gidigba. E dey feel when opponent shift body and e dey know where next struggle dey go.
skill-2: One wrestler after another begin fall for im front.
pride: At first, Joromi dey thank di people wey dey hail am. But as im win dey plenty, na so im pride dey grow.
pride-2: E no take time, e begin think say nobody dey for anywhere wey fit win am.
pride-2.ask: Why Joromi come get pride like dat?
sister: Im sister know say e get liver. But e still know say Joromi no like person wey dey advise am.
sister-2: When sister talk about limit, na as challenge e dey hear am.
palm: Near dia house, one palm tree dey wey dem warn am make e no climb.
palm-2: To Joromi, dat warning even sound like insult to im power.
climb: One day, e hold body of di tree and start to climb. Im sister shout call am.
climb-2: E no gree stop, e climb pass roof level, pass all di normal noise of village.
climb-2.ask: Why im sister come dey warn am?
beyond: Na so di tree carry am go pass di world wey e know. Di land of human beings dey down.
beyond-2: Another place open for im front, na where spirits dey gather to do wrestling.
challenge: Joromi look di arena. E don win all di strong men for human world.
challenge-2: Why e go turn back now? Eot step front and throw challenge.
fly: Im sister no gree abandon am.
fly-2: For dis story, e transform to small fly and follow am, carry im voice go where human leg no fit reach.
fly-2.ask: How im sister take help am?
stranger: Di spirits come dey look di stranger.
stranger-2: See man wey carry flesh and breath, wey stand for place wey no be im own, dey ask to fight spirits.
two-heads: One spirit wey get two heads come front. Joromi meet am for arena.
two-heads-2: Dem push each other gidigba, none of them gree give up, as all di spirits gather close.
patience: Di fight take time pass any match wey Joromi don ever play for house.
patience-2: Ordinary strength no reach again. E must to watch, wait, and find correct time to move.
voice: Im sister voice reach am inside all di noise. E call im name and remind am how far e don travel.
voice-2: But as e dey win, na so e dey enter more danger.
victory: Finally, Joromi win dat opponent. Di arena shake. E show say human being fit stand fight with spirit.
victory-2: But e still no think say make e go back house.
seven-heads: Another challenge come again. Di danger now big pass before.
seven-heads-2: One wicked spirit wey get seven heads ready to fight, and di air around am hot like fire.
tired: Na dat time Joromi first feel say im body don tire. Im hands heavy.
tired-2: E dey breathe hard hard. Na courage carry am come here; na pride make am stay.
tired-2.ask: Wetin dey change when Joromi body tire?
struggle: E still fight. Di spirit press am tight, no give am space to breathe well.
struggle-2: Im sister still dey near, im small voice dey speak inside all di confusion.
opening: Joromi struggle come out and see chance to run.
opening-2: Dis one no be ordinary village match where friends go carry am for shoulder when e win.
escape: E turn face back to house. E run come down from spirit world, leave all di champions behind.
escape-2: Di ground wey e know for body sweet pass another victory.
escape-2.ask: Why Joromi come decide to run away?
home: Im sister come back with am. E carry mind enter dat strange arena, think say na strength be answer to everything.
home-2: E come back now know say some question pass strength.
remember: Na di Joromi be dat wey people still remember for dis story: get liver to face dangerous enemy,
remember-2: but pride almost carry am go enter big trouble because e wan win everybody.
lesson: And when di papa finish, e leave one question near di fire.
lesson-2: Na di person wey dey continue fight always strong pass, abi strength dey mean sef when person know wen make e stop?
lesson-2.ask: E fit be say to know wen make person stop na another kind strength?

game.intro: Stand for one place. Use soft punch. Cover di side wey dey shine, bend down pass di high sweep, den punch di faces.
game.flat: Stay for one spot. Hold the left or right side of the screen make you guard (or A and D), hold down small to duck the high sweep (or S), then tap the face wey dey glow make you punch (or Space).
game.adaptation: One boxing game wey dem get inspiration from di wrestling story.
game.approach: Watch as di spirit dey come.
game.duck: Bend down for di high sweep
game.recover: Carry your hand come back. Watch di next style.
game.tracking: Show your two hands make you fit continue.
game.won: Practice don finish. To know wen make you stop na strength.
game.lost: Draw breath. Try dis spirit again.
